purpose: Implement and verify molecular import, explicit user-selected protein preparation, and visible explicit-solvent preview in DynaMol. Only tiny protein preparation/simulation smoke checks; no claims of accurate reconstruction, protein-design success, experimentally valid protonation or equilibrated MD.

reproducibility.scope: Existing source file is retained; new remote imports must retain original response bytes, source identifiers, dates and hashes.

data.policy: Preserve original sequence metadata and atom identity; do not infer residue identities from numbering gaps. Missing-residue building must be opt-in and based on explicit sequence evidence; rebuilt coordinates labeled modeled/uncertain. Protonation edits must be explicit, recorded and carried through engines without silent reset. Solvent preview must use exact retained coordinates for subsequent simulation, without double solvation. SMILES/source molecular states retain stereochemical and conformer provenance.

validation.status: Preflight only; implementation and smoke checks pending.
validation.scope: Test sequence provenance, missing-atom restoration, unsupported chemistry rejection, pH state preservation, index mapping, parameterizability, no duplicate solvent, viewer/source coordinate equivalence, and recorded alterations.

comparison.notes: No accuracy benchmark or scientific method comparison planned.

review_identity: Language-model implementation/evidence review; PatAgent is an automated public-writing-inspired checklist, not Pat Walters or expert certification.
